# Phero Go API

> Package a2a exposes phero agents as A2A servers and lets agents call remote A2A endpoints as tools.

## Go API

- [a2a](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-a2a.html): Package a2a exposes phero agents as A2A servers and lets agents call remote A2A endpoints as tools.
- [agent](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-agent.html): Package agent provides a small orchestration layer around an llm.LLM.
- [document](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-document.html): Package document defines the Document type returned by text splitters.
- [embedding](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-embedding.html): Package embedding defines a small, provider-agnostic interface for generating vector embeddings from text.
- [embedding/openai](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-embedding-openai.html): Package openai provides an OpenAI-backed Embedder implementation.
- [llm](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-llm.html): Package llm provides small, composable building blocks for driving LLM-backed applications.
- [llm/anthropic](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-llm-anthropic.html): Package anthropic provides an llm.LLM implementation backed by Anthropic's Messages API.
- [llm/middleware](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-llm-middleware.html): Package middleware provides built-in llm.Middleware implementations for the phero framework.
- [llm/openai](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-llm-openai.html): Package openai provides an llm.LLM implementation backed by the OpenAI Chat Completions API.
- [mcp](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-mcp.html): Package mcp provides adapters for working with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in this codebase.
- [memory](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-memory.html): Package memory defines the Memory interface for conversational context storage.
- [memory/jsonfile](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-memory-jsonfile.html): Package jsonfile provides a file-backed message store for agents.
- [memory/nats](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-memory-nats.html): Package natsmemory implements the memory.Memory interface using NATS JetStream Key-Value.
- [memory/psql](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-memory-psql.html): Package psql implements the memory.Memory interface using PostgreSQL.
- [memory/rag](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-memory-rag.html): Package rag provides a memory.Memory implementation backed by the project's retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) store.
- [memory/simple](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-memory-simple.html): Package simple provides a small in-memory message store for agents.
- [nats](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-nats.html): Package nats implements the NATS Agent Protocol v0.3 for Phero agents.
- [rag](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-rag.html): Package rag provides a small retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) helper.
- [skill](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-skill.html): Package skill provides helpers to discover and parse skill definitions.
- [textsplitter](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-textsplitter.html): Package textsplitter defines the shared abstractions for text splitting.
- [textsplitter/markdown](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-textsplitter-markdown.html): Package markdown provides a Markdown-aware text splitter.
- [textsplitter/recursive](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-textsplitter-recursive.html): Package recursive provides a recursive character-based text splitter.
- [tool/agent](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-tool-agent.html): Package agent provides a reusable tool wrapper for delegating tasks to another runnable agent.
- [tool/bash](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-tool-bash.html): Package bash provides a Phero tool that executes bash commands on behalf of an LLM agent.
- [tool/file](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-tool-file.html): Package file provides filesystem-oriented tools aligned with read/write/edit/glob/grep naming.
- [tool/human](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-tool-human.html): Package human provides a structured user interaction tool for agents.
- [tool/skill](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-tool-skill.html): Package skill provides a dispatcher tool that loads SKILL.md instructions into the current conversation.
- [trace](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-trace.html): Package trace provides observability hooks for phero agents and LLM calls.
- [trace/jsonfile](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-trace-jsonfile.html): Package jsonfile provides a file-backed Tracer that persists trace events as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON).
- [trace/otel](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-trace-otel.html): Package otel provides an OpenTelemetry-backed trace.Tracer that maps phero agent, LLM, and tool events onto OpenTelemetry spans.
- [trace/text](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-trace-text.html): Package text provides a human-readable, colour-coded Tracer implementation that writes one formatted line per event to an io.Writer.
- [vectorstore](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-vectorstore.html): Package vectorstore defines the Store interface for vector search backends.
- [vectorstore/psql](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-vectorstore-psql.html): Package psql implements the vectorstore.Store interface using PostgreSQL + pgvector.
- [vectorstore/qdrant](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-vectorstore-qdrant.html): Package qdrant implements the vectorstore.Store interface using Qdrant.
- [vectorstore/weaviate](/phero/docs/api/go-api/pkg-vectorstore-weaviate.html): Package weaviate provides a Weaviate-backed vectorstore.Store implementation using the official Weaviate Go client (v4).
- [Go API](/phero/docs/api/go-api.html): github.com/henomis/phero
